case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: An accountable human and meaningful review or effective correction of AI evaluations determining binding academic marks.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: While N168 and N169 vest final grade collation and approval in human staff and N113/N088 provide post-hoc review/appeal routes, no operative rule requires pre-mark human review of AI-generated intra-group evaluations before they determine peer marks.
case_summary.case_note: Murdoch's Grades Procedure (N168) and Results Procedure (N169) vest mark collation, moderation, and final grade approval in Unit Coordinators, Heads of Discipline, and Results Committees, while N113 and N088 provide re-mark and appeal routes. However, no operative policy governs an AI agent exercising managerial or peer-evaluation authority over human group members before marks are affected, leaving a critical gap. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15, and this proposal awaits human verification.
